split.method: deterministic global origin-filename family split after exact-byte deduplication
split.warning: MPID does not retain authoritative upstream-source identities. This split prevents known filename-family and exact-byte leakage but cannot prove upstream-source independence.

checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch; UK target images and MPID development metrics do not select a checkpoint
claim_boundary: Diagnostic direct three-material detector. MPID development metrics are not UK accuracy; UK scores are raw uncalibrated detector scores.
